regions.name: 科西嘉
regions.theme: 岛内港区、山地道路与小型工场
regions.project_zh: 岛内货物先在港区修配，再经山路送往各市镇。
regions.project_en: Repair island cargo in the port workshops and connect the towns through local roads.

regions.name: 法兰西岛
regions.theme: 塞纳工业带、近郊工场与城市公共服务
regions.project_zh: 以巴黎本地的小型机修、职工通勤与市政采购为重点。
regions.project_en: Focus on local machine shops, worker commuting and municipal purchasing in Paris.

regions.name: 布列塔尼
regions.theme: 沿海港镇、渔业供应与内陆市集
regions.project_zh: 由地方议会协调雷恩工场与布雷斯特港区。
regions.project_en: Coordinate Rennes workshops and the port of Brest through the regional council.

regions.name: 北部－加来
regions.theme: 北方煤矿、工业城镇与海峡港口
regions.project_zh: 把矿区的金属加工订单与敦刻尔克的沿海维修需求接起来。
regions.project_en: Connect metalworking orders in the mining basin with coastal repairs at Dunkirk.

regions.name: 普罗旺斯
regions.theme: 地中海港区、瓦尔矿区与内陆交通
regions.project_zh: 马赛承接港口加工订单，内陆道路服务现有矿区与市镇。
regions.project_en: Place port orders in Marseille and improve roads serving the existing inland mines and towns.

regions.name: 皮卡第
regions.theme: 乡村加工、工场修复与城际交通
regions.project_zh: 让亚眠工场与索姆河谷农产集散地共用稳定的运输合同。
regions.project_en: Give Amiens workshops and Somme valley produce markets reliable transport contracts.

regions.name: 弗朗什孔泰
regions.theme: 精密工场、山地通路与边区市镇
regions.project_zh: 精密工场重视工艺培训，多勒道路承担零件与木材转运。
regions.project_en: Train precision workers and move components and timber through Dole.

regions.name: 阿基坦
regions.theme: 吉伦特港运、地方工场与农产供应
regions.project_zh: 以地方加工与出口包装订单支持波尔多的河港腹地。
regions.project_en: Support the Bordeaux river-port hinterland with processing and export packaging orders.

regions.name: 奥弗涅
regions.theme: 内陆工场、山地交通与乡村供应
regions.project_zh: 城镇机修服务农业生产，山地道路缩短偏远市镇补给距离。
regions.project_en: Use town workshops for agricultural repairs and shorten mountain supply journeys.

regions.name: 香槟－阿登
regions.theme: 农产合同、工场维修与营地运输
regions.project_zh: 把纺织和农具订单留在本省，改善乡镇产品运往市场的道路。
regions.project_en: Keep textile and farm-tool orders in the province and improve access to rural markets.

regions.name: 勃艮第
regions.theme: 铁路枢纽、车间协作与城乡货运
regions.project_zh: 围绕现有金属加工区安排订单，并改善第戎铁路的公路接驳。
regions.project_en: Place orders with the existing metalworking district and improve road access to Dijon rail traffic.

regions.name: 利穆赞
regions.theme: 利摩日工场、轻装军需与乡村服务
regions.project_zh: 结合陶瓷、地方机修与小城集市，减少利穆赞内部运输损耗。
regions.project_en: Link ceramics, repair shops and town markets to reduce internal transport losses in Limousin.

regions.name: 罗讷－阿尔卑斯
regions.theme: 罗讷工业走廊、机电工场与山地运输
regions.project_zh: 把里昂的机械订单与阿尔卑斯山地的能源、运输需求相协调。
regions.project_en: Coordinate Lyon machinery orders with Alpine energy and transport needs.

regions.name: 洛林
regions.theme: 矿业检修、兵工工场与边区铁路
regions.project_zh: 优先维修现有冶金设备，并改善图勒一带的后方运输。
regions.project_en: Repair existing metallurgical equipment and improve rear-area transport near Toul.

regions.name: 朗格多克－鲁西永
regions.theme: 沿海货运、地方矿务与乡村灌溉
regions.project_zh: 合作加工连接内陆农产与沿海市场，不另造本省没有的矿产。
regions.project_en: Connect inland produce processing with coastal markets through local cooperatives.

regions.name: 卢瓦尔河地区
regions.theme: 河口船厂、港区配套与农业腹地
regions.project_zh: 订单投向圣纳泽尔船厂，南特的腹地道路负责材料与职工运输。
regions.project_en: Place orders in Saint-Nazaire shipyards and move materials and workers through Nantes.

regions.name: 普瓦图－夏朗德
regions.theme: 乡村信用、军械工艺与港运维修
regions.project_zh: 沙泰勒罗加工零件，拉罗谢尔负责沿海船舶维修与地方货运。
regions.project_en: Make components in Chatellerault and repair coastal vessels at La Rochelle.

regions.name: 诺曼底
regions.theme: 塞纳河海运输、金属工场与乡村供应
regions.project_zh: 把卡昂的金属维修与勒阿弗尔的港口船舶需求共同纳入采购。
regions.project_en: Coordinate procurement for Caen metal repairs and Le Havre harbour vessels.

regions.name: 阿尔萨斯
regions.theme: 莱茵河港、精密工场与双语公共服务
regions.project_zh: 连接米卢斯工场与莱茵河港公路；内河运输改善以基础设施体现。
regions.project_en: Connect Mulhouse workshops with Rhine river-port roads through infrastructure investment.

regions.name: 南部－比利牛斯
regions.theme: 图卢兹航空工艺、地方工场与山地供应
regions.project_zh: 培养图卢兹的航空加工工人，并保障塔布与山地市镇的道路运输。
regions.project_en: Train Toulouse aviation workers and support road transport through Tarbes and mountain towns.

regions.name: 中央大区
regions.theme: 卢瓦尔干线、军械试验与农产集散
regions.project_zh: 由布尔日承接试制与检验订单，以图尔接驳道路运送零件。
regions.project_en: Place prototype and inspection orders in Bourges and move components through Tours.

PCF.name: 共产党
PCF.method: 由工会和街区支部监督订单、工资与质量，公开工场和运输合同的执行记录。
PCF.method_en: Let unions and neighbourhood branches supervise orders, wages and quality, with public contract records.

SFIO.name: 工人国际法国支部
SFIO.method: 通过雇主、工会与地方议会的协议，把新增订单转化为稳定岗位和可负担的通勤。
SFIO.method_en: Use employer, union and council agreements to turn new orders into stable jobs and affordable commuting.

PRRRS.name: 激进党
PRRRS.method: 以透明预算和合作信贷支持小业主，把市镇的加工、运输与市场服务连成一体。
PRRRS.method_en: Support small owners through transparent budgets and cooperative credit, linking production, transport and markets.

USR.name: 社会主义共和联盟
USR.method: 由工程师和地方行政共同制定设备标准、运输时刻和项目进度，减少相互脱节。
USR.method_en: Let engineers and local administrators coordinate equipment standards, schedules and project milestones.

PUP.name: 无产阶级团结党
PUP.method: 让生产合作社和互助组织自行选举监督代表，以会员决定协调地方订单与运输。
PUP.method_en: Let cooperatives and mutual-aid associations elect supervisors and coordinate orders through member decisions.

RG_AD.name: 民主联盟
RG_AD.method: 以限额信贷和公开招标调动地方商会，按交付进度付款并审计地方运输合同。
RG_AD.method_en: Mobilise local chambers through capped credit and open tenders, paying for deliveries and auditing freight contracts.

FR_URD.name: 共和联盟
FR_URD.method: 将地方工场纳入防务订货，由地方行政与预备役代表检查供货质量和运输保障。
FR_URD.method_en: Include local workshops in defence procurement, with administrators and reservists inspecting quality and transport.

PDP.name: 人民民主党
PDP.method: 以家庭补助、行业协商和地方社会机构协调工场岗位与通勤服务，保护小型生产者。
PDP.method_en: Coordinate workshop jobs and commuting through family support, sector negotiations and local social institutions.

UPR.name: 阿尔萨斯人民共和联盟
UPR.method: 通过双语技工培训与地方自治机构，把米卢斯加工和斯特拉斯堡河港运输纳入本地法制。
UPR.method_en: Use bilingual technical training and local institutions to coordinate Mulhouse production and Strasbourg river-port transport.

DORIOT.name: 多里奥地方组织
DORIOT.method: 把地方组织的技工训练、工场订单与街区服务落实到巴黎市政；既有独立与人民党选择继续保留。
DORIOT.method_en: Apply local technical training, workshop orders and neighbourhood services to Paris, retaining the existing independent or PPF choice.

scope: 20 regions with existing party branches; Brittany keeps its council tree. Historical party presence is unchanged. Native old-save migration and campaign rewards require in-game verification.
